lessons.name: THE CONTROL: SHARING DOES OCCUR ABOVE THE LEAF. Handles 00bc4bbe and 00bc4bc1 are two records of this store with one third-level folder, 00bc4b, and at that level 71,555 folders hold 71,711 leaves — which shows the footprint is a measurement of this store and not a constant two-per-record identity that would pass whatever the store held.

A STORE'S COST TO ITS HOST IS COUNTED IN INODES, NOT RECORDS. Leaving out this wing's own 3 records, 71,711 leaves sit under 256 + 43,569 + 71,555 + 71,711 folders across the 4 levels, so with the root the store occupies 258,803 inodes — more than three for every record it holds. The floor is two by construction: the deepest folder is named by the whole handle and no two records share one, so that level holds exactly one folder per leaf (71,711 for 71,711), and every record costs its file and its own folder before any level above is counted. On 2026-09-13 that footprint filled the build host's vnode table and panicked the machine twice; a resource the host must hold per inode is the surface, and it is sealed here so the next growth is measured before it is felt.
